title: forge run data
description: Payload of `forge run --json`: the program's `say` output and its return value, the diagnostics that blocked it, or — with `--dry-run` — the static plan of what would run. `say` never writes to stdout in JSON mode, wherever it runs — `fn main`, a spawned agent or a pool worker — so `output` is the whole program output and `cost` covers the run (`0.0` with `--dry-run`, where nothing runs and the plan estimate is `estimated_cost_usd`).

anyOf.title: dry run
anyOf.description: `--dry-run`: the same plan `forge cost --json` reports, plus `dry_run`. Nothing was executed and no provider was built; warnings keep exit 2 without blocking the plan.

anyOf.title: dry run blocked
anyOf.description: `--dry-run` with checker errors: no plan is reported, only the diagnostics (`error.type` is `check`).

file.description: Program file, or the manifest path when `--manifest` was used.

result.description: The program's return value, or `null` when it returned nothing (`Unit`).

anyOf.title: blocked
anyOf.description: Static checks failed, so the program never started; `error.type` is `check` and `next_steps` suggests `forge check --json <file>`.
